case_number: Civil Appeal No(s). ... of 2023; Arising out of SLP (C) No. 15793 OF 2019, Civil Appeal No(s). ... of 2023; Arising out of SLP (C) No. 15848 OF 2019

parties.respondent: Pyare Ram & Ors; Sunder Singh & Anr.

summary: Specific performance suit; appellant non-party to original land sale contracts (agricultural land, Himachal Pradesh); challenges dismissal due to delay in filing; 254-day delay; insufficient funds claimed as reason; Section 5 Limitation Act, 1963 condonation denied; Section 149 CPC permits payment of deficient court fees within time; Section 4 Court Fees Act read with Section 149 CPC; Mannan Lal precedent on retrospective cure of court fee deficiency; no sufficient cause shown for delay.
legal_provisions_cited: Mannan Lal v. Mst. Chhotaka Bibi & Ors.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; condonation refused; High Court order upheld.
